apps.name: WeeklyPlanner
apps.tagline: Plan training and study sessions, and feed them to LevelUp
apps.description: Plans and times the five areas it owns for LevelUp: Strength & Combat Skills, Tech Skills, Musicianship, Career, and Study Math. Schedule sessions on a day or week grid, run a timer, set weekly training targets like 3 BJJ and 2 Muay Thai, and break study subjects into modules and lessons. Every completed session checks the matching activity off in LevelUp automatically. Styled after the Solo Leveling System. Works fully offline.

apps.name: LevelUp
apps.tagline: Level up your life across nine categories
apps.description: A gamified personal-development tracker. Earn XP and level up across nine life categories, log activities and daily habits, complete daily and weekly quests, and track vices with streaks. Works fully offline.

apps.name: SupplementTracker
apps.tagline: Track your supplement and peptide doses
apps.description: Schedule recurring supplement and peptide doses with local reminders, mark them taken each day, and review your dose history. Styled after the Solo Leveling System. Works fully offline.
